# Vendored

`preact-htm.js` is `preact/standalone.module.js` from the npm package `htm` 3.1.1, unchanged. It bundles Preact, Preact hooks, and htm in one ES module, so the page needs no build step and makes no outside requests.

- htm: Apache-2.0, `LICENSE-htm`
- Preact: MIT, `LICENSE-preact`
